احتقبتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبَتَا (iḥtaqabatā) /iħ.ta.qa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبَتَا (uḥtuqibatā) /uħ.tu.qi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
